name: Floatsy — Chat Button Widget
author: Berkay Yavuz

sections.description:
Floatsy adds a stunning, fully customizable floating chat button stack to your WordPress website. Connect with your visitors instantly via the world’s most popular messaging platforms. Zero coding required — configure everything from a modern, multilingual admin panel.

🌍 11 Admin Panel Languages: English, Turkish, Chinese, Spanish, Arabic, Hindi, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, German, French

Key Features

Multi-Platform Support
* WhatsApp — with optional popup chat or direct link mode
* Telegram — link directly to your channel or username
* Instagram — link to your Instagram profile
* Facebook — Facebook Messenger direct link
* Phone — click-to-call button
* Email — click-to-email button
* Enable only the platforms you need — all others stay hidden

Smart Fan Layout
* 1 platform active → single floating button, direct action on click
* 2+ platforms active → one main button, animated fan-out on click
* Each platform button shows in its own brand color with smooth animations

Per-Platform Visibility Control
* Hide any platform on mobile devices independently
* Hide any platform on desktop independently
* Full control over which button appears where

WhatsApp Popup Chat
* Beautiful WhatsApp-style popup with chat bubble
* Custom agent name, profile photo, status text
* Custom welcome message and pre-filled message
* Online/Offline status based on business hours

Business Hours
* Set working days (Mon–Sun individually)
* Set start and end times
* Show custom offline message outside hours

Appearance
* 5 button shapes: Circle, Rounded Square, Square, Leaf, Drop
* Per-platform custom colors
* Pulse / ripple animation
* Notification badge with custom count
* Tooltip text next to button
* Configurable display delay

Visibility Controls
* Show/hide widget on desktop
* Show/hide widget on mobile
* Hide on specific pages by ID

Multilingual Admin Panel
* English · Türkçe · 中文 · Español · العربية · हिन्दी · Português · Русский · 日本語 · Deutsch · Français

Installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Upload floatsy-chat-widget.zip and click Install Now
  3. Activate the plugin
  4. Go to Floatsy Chat in the left menu
  5. Enable the platforms you want and enter your details
  6. Click Save Settings — done!
sections.faq:
How do I set up WhatsApp?

Go to Platforms tab, enable WhatsApp, enter your phone number with country code (no + sign). Example: 905551234567 for Turkey, 15551234567 for USA.

Can I use only specific platforms?

Yes! Each platform has its own enable/disable toggle. Enable only the ones you want.

What happens with multiple platforms?

When 2 or more platforms are enabled, a single main floating button appears. Clicking it reveals all platform buttons with a smooth fan animation. No clutter on your site.

Can I hide a platform on mobile only?

Yes! Each platform has “Hide on Mobile” and “Hide on Desktop” checkboxes. Mix and match as needed.

How do business hours work?

Enable Business Hours in the Availability tab. Set working days and hours. Outside those hours, the WhatsApp popup shows your offline message instead.

Does it slow down my website?

No. All scripts load only when the widget is active. The footprint is minimal and optimized for Core Web Vitals.

Can I change the admin panel language?

Yes! Go to the Language tab and pick from 11 languages including Turkish, Arabic (RTL), Chinese, and more.
